verdict.rationale: Stable's marketing and pricing pages claim AI-generated document summaries of mail contents and an 'AI-powered inbox' that sorts and routes mail automatically. That covers AI insights drawn from the user's own data inside the product, but the evidence is one-line marketing claims with no detail on depth or scope, and nothing shows actionable suggestions. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-generated suggestions or recommendations beyond summaries, in-depth documentation of how the AI summaries and insights work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
